name: SHATTER MERIDIAN: AR Territory Wars
description: One of the earliest citywide AR territorial conquest games, SHATTER MERIDIAN divided GLMZ into 400 hexagonal zones that real players had to physically occupy and defend using BCI-linked AR overlays. Teams of up to twelve players used encoded signal emitters to 'claim' infrastructure nodes — transit hubs, water towers, vertical farm access points — while rival squads attempted to physically displace them. The game's first season in 2185 drew unprecedented cross-tier participation until Tier 1 players began using the game's zone mechanics to actually blockade corporate supply routes, prompting an emergency patch and the first of many 'Shelf Exclusion Zones.'
story_hooks: A player discovers that certain legacy zone-claim coordinates in the game correspond exactly to pre-Sable Charter property lines — someone encoded a land rights map into the original game geometry.
A Tier 1 runner is hired to physically escort a high-value game node emitter through contested Shelf territory, but the package turns out to be far more than a game token.
A retired SHATTER MERIDIAN champion now runs a Tier 2 neighborhood watch using the game's original zone-control protocols, which she never stopped maintaining.
